operation.summary: Get cart details (authenticated customer or guest)
operation.description: Returns the active cart with items, totals, coupons, shipping/payment method, and addresses. Works for both a logged-in customer and a guest; the cart is always identified by the Bearer token (the customer token, or the guest cart token from POST /api/shop/cart-token). A cart id in the body is ignored. It is a POST (not GET) because reading the cart recalculates totals; the GraphQL equivalent is the `createReadCart` mutation for the same reason. Body may be an empty `{}` for a logged-in customer.

parameters.name: X-STOREFRONT-KEY
parameters.description: Storefront API Key for authentication. Required for all shop/storefront API requests.

parameters.name: X-Locale
parameters.description: Locale code for localized data (e.g. "en", "fr", "ar"). Defaults to channel's default locale.

parameters.name: X-Channel
parameters.description: Channel code (e.g. "default"). Defaults to the current channel.

parameters.name: X-Currency
parameters.description: Currency code (e.g. "USD", "EUR", "INR"). Defaults to channel's base currency.
